process_nodes.label: Foveros
process_nodes.note: Intel's 3D packaging technology, made at high volume at Fab 9 and the adjoining Fab 11X.

summary: A new advanced packaging factory adjoining Fab 11X at Intel's Rio Rancho campus in New Mexico. It came from a $3.5 billion plan announced in May 2021 to equip the New Mexico operations for Foveros 3D packaging, with construction expected from late 2021. Intel opened Fab 9 on 24 January 2024; with Fab 11X it forms Intel's first co-located high-volume advanced packaging site. Intel later put the Rio Rancho investment above $4 billion and describes New Mexico as its key advanced packaging facility.
